title: Rakugaki Mario - FAKE FINAL (real final classic remix)
description:
The theme used in the level "Life has it's Ups and Downs" from Rakugaki Mario. This is a downported version of "real final" from R-ACK, which that song can be downloaded here. Not to be confused with the unsampled version. This can work for airships, castles, water levels, title screens, cutscenes, or even space levels.

This is specifically designed to emulate the same style as those older japanese ports from back then, which itself has a nostalgic feel for a lot of the older SMW hacking folk, me included. Of course, this "style" is not exclusive to japanese ports (a lot of older FPI and S.N.N. ports have that same feel), which is why it's more accurate to call it a "classic remix".
